pr_title: Update to vscode-eslint 2.4.4 & support flat config file extensions
pr_body:
This upgrades to vscode-eslint 2.4.4 to support flat configs, in multiple configuration files, ending in `.js`, `.cjs`, `.mjs`.

We changed the code to not use the GitHub release because we actually don't need the artifacts of the release, we just need the source code, which we compile anyway.

Fixes #7271.

Release Notes:

- Added support for ESLint flat config files. ([#7271](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/7271)).

3. eslint RPC logs: `debug: open language server debug logs`, turn on RPC calls for `eslint`, then hit save in your file, then look in those logs

issue_context.title: Support for ESLint's new configuration format (FlatConfig)
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues

- [X] Completed

### Describe the feature

Related discussion: https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/discussions/7204

FlatConfig: https://eslint.org/docs/latest/use/configure/configuration-files-new

ESLint announced this new configuration format about half or 1 years ago, and now it's feature completed and able to use, there has been a lot of plugins supporting it. It contains several improvements like the ability to use ESM instead of CJS for config itself and the ability to use different configs for different files through file and ignore patterns.

After several tries to solve this, I found *this* is related to the problem:
https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/8bafc61ef57f8f1807ced6f8b69891c4ee701a7d/crates/zed/src/languages/typescript.rs#L217-L232

Maybe we need to build a settings entry that will add `"experimental": { "useFlatConfig": true }` to workspace settings (above) passed to `vscode-eslint/.../eslintServer.js`

But, since this will be my very first time to write and debug rust program if I try to solve this by myself, I filed this issue instead to look around for some potential help.

❤️

### If applicable, add mockups / screenshots to help present your vision of the feature


_No response_

We landed support in #8109 _but_ the vscode-eslint extension needs to be updated to a version 2.3.0 or later for it to take effect. [Unfortunately it seems like there won't be any more versions released on the GitHub releases page](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-eslint/pull/1770#issuecomment-1963707143) so we'd need to revise the code a bit in a effort to access some ESLint language server.

I cloned the `vscode-eslint` repo, compiled the code and changed the reference in zed to that JS file and got the flat config working.

![image](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/318208/34dba082-1fde-4d71-ab79-80669a45b000)

So it kind of depends on what we'd like to do to get newer versions of `vscode-eslint`. We could clone and build the project in zed, or prebuild it and ship it with zed. Also possible for someone (I could do it) to set up a different npm package that just exposes the build `vscode-eslint` language server and we could install that.

I'm happy to work making a PR to zed with these changes but I'm unsure what approach we'd like to take.

cc/ @SomeoneToIgnore since we talked about ESLint LSP stuff in #8109.
